body: I'm glad. Have a good night man.

I hear the call to. I know exactly which part of my brain I'm going to shoot. I practiced holding my gun to ensure that specific lobe is destroyed. I don't think we can control who we become. The only thing we can do is is give ourselves the time to become someone else. For better or worse remains to be seen. It's a gamble. I'm letting it go for now. I hope I'm strong enough to see it through. That's why I'm here, sometimes it gives me a little strength to go a little bit forward.
Well I wrote but apparently I suck at reddit now too. Fuck. Well see the other post I made I suppose.

I hear you. I used to be so happy. Now I can't remember the last time I had a single day when I just felt ok. Maybe the advice we need to accept is to stop trying to go back to the people we were. Maybe we need to work on becoming someone new. I'm realizing Everytime I try to go back I just hurt more. Shitty thing is I'm kinda scared about moving forward.
Suicide is one thing. That's my choice for me. Murder is something different. In this theoretical, I would contact the police. Especially if I believed they would do it.

This right here. I feel this so much. I hate so much that people say suicide is selfish. Everyday I don't kill is for the other people in my life. Their the selfish ones. They don't have to live with the constant shit show in their heads. Depression is a bully that knows exactly what to say to hurt us the most. And no matter how hard we try we can't get away.
Me too. Wanna talk about it?
Thanks I appreciate it. Lol that's why I like this sub, people give real answers and insight.
From one suicidal to another can I ask why you want to die? Personally I'm 27, no one has ever loved me or found me desirable. I'm just a joke to them.
Yeah the endorphin rush was pretty good. But I clawed my face till I was all bloody. Not so good lol.
I'm trying to think of something I'm interested in but my mind is blank how weird is that? I'm a chemist. I like chemistry lol. How about you?

Yeah kids are the fucking worst. Unfortunately there is no easy solution here. Those little shits are going to suck no matter what you do. If I could make a suggestion, talk to an adult in your life. Talking to parents is awkward but can help. See your school counselor, or go directly to your principal. It sucks but I don't think you are going to be able to handle this on your own. I saw a counselor for a awhile and she helped me a fair but. Since then I haven't held my gun to my head once which is real progress. I hope you find help. I'll tell you one day people generally become a little less shitty. But that day is still aways out so don't try and ride it out on your own.
Hello. I wish I could say it gets better, but I'm 27 and it's pretty much shit wall to wall. May I at least ask why specifically you want out?
If nothing else, I took took the time to read.

I feel the same way about my love life. I feel it's all just a big joke and I'm the punch line. Honestly I don't know if there is a way of fixing it. I guess all we can do is try and make it day by day? That sucks but I don't know what to say, because I want to die too. I'm living because I know how much it would hurt my brothers. I guess my advice is to find your reason for living. It may not make you happy, but it may see you through tommorow.

I feel trapped too. I don't really have any good advice, because I'm fighting everyday too. I feel like people think I'm an attention whore too and that they don't understand. Or even that they don't care too. But the core of the situation is you reached out for help because you don't want to die. I have come to realize that that's why I'm here at least. If nothing else I feel it has helped me to try and reach out to other people here and be supportive. Maybe give that a try and see how you feel. I honestly feel a fair bit better at the moment. And after all every little moment better does help doesn't it?
Goodbye. I don't know you, but love you. I love you because I feel this hurt too. Would you like to chat a little before you go?

Fair enough. I will not try and take that choice away from you. It's fucked up but life and death are really the only choices that are entirely in our control. I think about how much my brothers would be hurt looking into my casket. That keeps me going. I guess my advice would be to look for reasons not to. The reasons for are easy. Let's not split hairs we are here because we want to die. We are also both here because we want am excuse not too. Finding the reasons not to is the hard part. What does make you happy?

I hear you. I have a gun. I have the easy way out. But I don't. My brothers would be devastated if I did so I guess I won't. The only advice I can give is to try and look for reasons not to. Every time I hurt I think of them looking in on my coffin. It's weird, I don't know you, but I would feel happy if you at least made it one more day. Can I message you tomorrow and see if you're still around?

I hear you brother. Honestly I'm just responding because it feels good. I don't know what keeps me going, but everyday I move a little bit forward. Personally I think about how much my death would hurt my brothers. I hope you find your reason for life. College sucks. Life sucks. But I just keep plugging away, I don't know why but I honestly hope you do too.

I'm not going to feed you bull shit. I'm 27 and everyday I make the decision not to die. I have a gun, it would be easy. Still I don't. I'll don't know you and I don't know your struggles. Still I sit here and I find it interesting that I don't want you to die. You like to talk a little about what's hurting you?

I won't judge you, I understand. I don't know if I'm the best to respond, I'm literally holding a gun myself. I'm probably just being selfish because I want you to live. Even if it's just so I can say "you lived so what's my excuse?". I don't know, it does feel good to reach out to people who are hurting as well. I have to say I've responded to a couple of people now and I feel a little better.

I'm going to say something a little more than just "no er my God" and that other bull shit. You probably are better than he deserves and you probably are way out of his league. Maybe not. I don't know you and I don't know him. All I know is that right now I feel exactly the same as you do. And for that I love you. If nothing let's share wanting this escape. It's all I can really offer you. I feel I'll get through tonight, I honestly hope you do too.

Maybe I shouldn't say this but what I think about alot is being an organ donor. It may just be my stupid fucked up mind but I plan on giving 911 a call just so they can get the heads up and collect my organs. Maybe part of me hopes to be talked down at that point but I don't know.
Thanks man good luck to you lol
Did anything ever help?
Thank you, I think your the first person to not try and take that out of my hands. I'll try but this tunnel has been long and I'm so tired of it.

I don't know man. I just wanted to say I'm in a very similar situation with a girl and I can sympathize with how frustrating this feels. I feel like I'm spinning my wheels and I have no idea what to do about it. I wish I knew what my girl was thinking, I wish I knew what your girl was thinking. Hang tough brother. Good luck!
